1.mascotDialogue: One rule, no exception — everything dey happen for the top! You wan touch anywhere else, my pikin, na not stack you want.

2.mascotDialogue: `top` na the stack whole memory of where she dey stand! Minus one, empty. MAX minus one, full. Everything else na just that one number, dey move up and down.

3.mascotDialogue: Look — TOP marker dey sit for index 2, two empty space still dey above! That headroom, na the whole point sef.

4.mascotDialogue: The function do her job well — she talk say no! The fault belong to the caller wey no listen. Na why we dey show the broken state honestly, one slot wey pass capacity, dey there open — never hidden, never secret.
